create_GuiPickHelper: create a GuiPickHelper instance with an AppService and user index for GUI object picking
call_on_environment_reset: call on_environment_reset to refresh the rigid object manager and clear pick candidate indices
call_get_pick_object_near_query_position: call get_pick_object_near_query_position to find the nearest graspable object within the threshold distance
call_viz_objects: call viz_objects to draw highlight rings around all scene objects or pick candidates in the GUI
call_closest_point_and_dist_to_ray: call _closest_point_and_dist_to_ray to compute the closest point and distance from a ray to a set of 3D points
